<style>
#title-block-header h1,

.title h1 {
  text-align: center;

.publications-page {

  padding: 2rem 0 4rem 0;
}

.publications-container {
  max-width: 1050px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 0 2rem;
}

.year-heading {
  background-color: #5f705f;
  color: white;
  padding: 0.6rem 1rem;
  margin: 2rem 0 1rem 0;
  font-size: 1.4rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}

.pub-card {
  background-color: white;
  border-left: 6px solid #5f705f;
  padding: 1.2rem 1.4rem;
  margin-bottom: 1.2rem;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
}

.pub-number {
  font-weight: 800;
  color: #5f705f;
  margin-right: 0.35rem;
}

.pub-title {
  font-style: italic;
  font-size: 1.05rem;
  margin: 0.35rem 0;
}

.pub-journal {
  font-weight: 700;
}

.pub-link a {
  color: #5f705f;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.pub-link a:hover {
  text-decoration: underline;
}

.pub-meta {
  margin-top: 0.7rem;
}

@media (max-width: 700px) {
  .publications-container {
    padding: 0 1.2rem;
  }

  .pub-card {
    padding: 1rem;
  }
}
</style>
